user.title: Energy Sensor Generator
user.description: Creates kWh energy sensors from your power sensors. You can pick which devices to track after setup.

data_description.sample_interval: How often energy is calculated. 60 seconds is a good default.
data_description.debug_logging: Writes detailed calculation logs. Turn this off once you are done troubleshooting.

abort.already_configured: Energy Sensor Generator is already configured

init.title: Energy Sensor Generator
init.description:
{overview}

Choose a section to edit, then Save when you are done.

sensors.title: Power sensors
sensors.description: {count} power sensors found. Tick the ones that should get kWh energy sensors.

data.custom_power_sensor: Add a sensor that was not detected

data_description.selected_power_sensors: Grouped by device. Multi-phase meters show L1/L2/L3 under the meter name.
data_description.custom_power_sensor: Use this for a power entity that was not listed above.
data_description.period_sensors: Daily / weekly / monthly / annual sensors that reset automatically.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Calculation and diagnostic settings. Defaults are suitable for most installs.

data_description.sample_interval: How often energy is calculated. Shorter is slightly more accurate and uses more resources.
data_description.debug_logging: Writes detailed calculation logs. Turn off afterwards to avoid log spam.
data_description.use_statistical_calculation: Uses recorder history (same approach as the Energy dashboard) instead of point sampling.
data_description.force_statistical_only: Skip point sampling even when history is briefly unavailable.
data_description.stat_initial_lookback_minutes: How far back to look the first time a new sensor is created.
data_description.max_energy_per_hour: Reject a reading larger than this (0 disables the limit).
data_description.create_synthetic_grid_total: Optional sum of all generated energy sensors. Requires a reload.

constant_devices.title: Constant power devices

data_description.constant_device_action: Add or update a device, then choose Done to return to the menu.
data_description.constant_device_switch: The switch or input boolean that turns the load on.
data_description.constant_device_power: Rated wattage while the switch is on (enter 3000 for 3 kW).
data_description.constant_device_name: Override the name shown on the generated energy sensor.
data_description.constant_device_remove: Only needed when Action is Remove device.

price_adjustments.title: Electricity price add-ons

data_description.price_adjust_action: Add or update an add-on, then choose Done to return to the menu.
data_description.price_adjust_source: The sensor that reports the spot or base price.
data_description.price_adjust_add_amount: Transmission, tax, or other adder in the same unit as the source.
data_description.price_adjust_name: Override the name shown on the adjusted price sensor.
data_description.price_adjust_remove: Only needed when Action is Remove adjustment.

error.invalid_entity_format: Invalid entity format. All entities must start with 'sensor.'

error.no_constant_devices: No constant power devices available to modify.
error.price_adjust_missing_fields: Select a source sensor and add-on amount before adding an entry.
error.price_adjust_invalid_amount: Enter a valid number for the add-on amount.
error.no_price_adjustments: No electricity price add-ons available to modify.
